candidate_contract: one store-wide inter-process serialization domain for ensure/claim/markRunning/Done/Failed/Uncertain
bounded wait with explicit timeout code
dead-owner recovery uses atomic rename of lock directory; never blind rm of a possibly replaced lock
release verifies pid+random ownership token before deleting lock
no age-based deletion of a live owner; timeout fail-closed instead

checks.lock_scope: before readState through durable whole-file replace

limits: Linux hosted process semantics only; Windows lock-directory semantics still need native proof if adopted
